title: docs: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and quickstarts
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Add a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) templates, agent/tool-calling examples, and corresponding quickstarts to the docs and examples repos. Motivation: make it easier for engineers to onboard to Redwood's RAG + agent patterns by providing vetted templates and runnable examples that demonstrate tool calling, structured output, and common rollout patterns.

What this PR includes: checklist:
- [x] RAG templates for FAQ, long-document search, and issue summarization (docs + example configs)
- [x] Agent examples demonstrating tool calling (HTTP tool, SQL query tool, and a simple ticketing API) with clear safety/timeouts
- [x] Quickstarts (docs site + redwood-examples) with step-by-step runner scripts and minimal infra instructions (hosted + dedicated notes)
- [x] Docs site pages and navigation updates (quickstarts index, agent guide)
- [x] Unit and integration smoke tests for the examples (CI)

Key design notes: templates are parameterized (embedding index name, retrieval window, chunk size) and include recommended batching/cache hints for Dedicated. Agent examples use the new tool-calling helper in the SDK and show how to configure function/tool schemas so structured responses are produced. No runtime/core-serving code changes in this PR — examples and docs only.

Commits (high level):
- add: docs/quickstarts/rag/{faq,long-doc,issue-summarize} templates and markdown quickstarts
- add: redwood-examples/agents/tool-calling/{http-sample,sql-sample,ticketing-sample} with Dockerfile and test harness
- update: redwood-docs site navigation, add agent guide and quickstarts index
- test: add smoke CI workflow for examples and a short e2e job that runs the dockerized samples against a mock tool endpoint

Files changed overview: docs/quickstarts/rag/ (3 new templates), redwood-examples/agents/tool-calling/ (3 new examples + Dockerfiles), redwood-docs/content/docs/agents.md (new guide), redwood-docs/content/docs/quickstarts.md (index + links), .github/workflows/examples-smoke.yml (CI), README updates.

Local testing notes: ran the smoke examples locally with an ephemeral vector DB (faiss) and the mock tool server included in the repo. CI smoke job runs the same sequence in GitHub Actions (starts mock server, builds example, runs quickstart script).

Release notes:
- Added RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts for developers to bootstrap retrieval+agent patterns.

No breaking changes.
